notes: The Plane of Sky's passages (petition 1608, the GM Jibrish: 'This needs to ask for a key from the boss and then teleport people to the next island'; petition 1612: 'after granavik dies he needs to drop 20 keys, and open a portal to the next island called Rain Key 3'): a key per isle, twenty on its boss's corpse (npcitem: one stack of 20, every kill), the isle's essence taking one to send the giver and the group by it on (handlers/skypass.go); Granavik's death opens the Rain 3 Portal where he fell for 15 minutes, which takes a Rain Key 3 to the fourth isle; the chains' essence steps lose their own teleports (the passage moves the player now, key in hand); the Mark of Desolation sends those who finished the chain of snow to the first isle of desolation (waysender.go). The isles' order and bosses: EQOA-Data's Portal/plane-of-sky guide and the sky-twins set's shard bosses; the keys' names follow Jibrish's 'Rain Key 3'.

items.description: A key Artiokanis carried, of the first isle of rain. The essence of rain there takes it and sends its bearer, and the group beside them, on to the next isle.

npcs.name: Rain 3 Portal
npcs.note: Granavik's portal (petition 1612): stood where he fell for 15 minutes by the trigger Rain 3 Portal Opens; takes a Rain Key 3 to the fourth isle of rain (handlers/skypass.go).

triggers.name: Rain 3 Portal Opens

steps.text: A portal tears open where Granavik fell. A Rain Key 3 opens it to the next isle; it closes in fifteen minutes.

triggers.notes: Petition 1612 (Jibrish): Granavik's death opens a portal to the next isle. Fired where he fell (npcdeath).

deaths.name: Granavik
deaths.note: Petition 1612 (Jibrish): his portal to the fourth isle of rain.
